value: Fixed floor 1.5 is a comparison assumption, not a measured irreducible loss.
Log(loss-floor) is affine in log(full training compute) independently at 5% knots, with jointly imposed non-increasing progress constraints over d512-to-d6144 compute.
Log excess loss is linearly interpolated between knots. Flats are allowed; no imposed temporal power law.
Compute includes lm_head, unlike Larry's original Paloma fit.
Completed d512/d768/d1024 fit both curves. Partial d1536 is held out, not imputed.
Averaged paired mixture response uses signed main and cooldown coefficients and actual per-run transition positions; both forecast curves are constrained monotone.
Hero losses are excluded; the pre-swap hero prediction is positively biased relative to observations.
Only three independent complete width pairs; sensitivity ranges are not confidence intervals.
Displayed range starts at 25000; no step-zero forecast.

method.value: Monotone per-progress H100 scaling fit; signed two-phase paired mixture response
